title: Write the alerts
summary: The checkout service has metrics but no useful alerts. Write four Prometheus alert rules that page for real outages and stay quiet for blips, quiet nights and other services.

checks.name: The rules load
checks.description: promtool check rules passes, and alerts.yml defines CheckoutInstanceDown, CheckoutTargetsMissing, CheckoutHighErrorRate and CheckoutSlowRequests once each, with the severity label from the brief and a summary and an https runbook_url annotation. No rule uses keep_firing_for, reads a series other than the metrics in the brief and its own recording rules (ALERTS included), reads the clock, uses @ or offset, or looks back more than an hour.

checks.name: Instance down
checks.description: Random scenarios: an instance that stays down alerts after 3 minutes, one alert per instance, even while the others fail and are slow; a 2-minute blip does not alert; an instance of another job does not alert.

checks.name: Targets missing
checks.description: Random scenarios: when every checkout target disappears, or was never scraped, it alerts after 5 minutes; instances that are down but still scraped and another job's targets do not count.

checks.name: Error rate
checks.description: Random scenarios: a service-wide 5xx share over 5% across 5 minutes, even just over, at 1 request per second or more, alerts once it has lasted 5 minutes, not sooner or later, and stops after the errors end; whatever the 5xx codes and routes, for a flaky dependency, next to a busy healthy service, and while an instance is down and requests are slow. Under 5%, many 4xx, under 1 request per second, and one small failing route or instance do not alert.

checks.name: Slow requests
checks.description: Random scenarios: a p95 for checkout's /api/checkout over 500 ms, even only about 750 ms, alerts once it has lasted 10 minutes, not sooner or later, with severity ticket, even next to a busy fast service and while an instance is down and many requests fail. A p95 under 500 ms (even about 375 ms), a slow route or job elsewhere, one small slow instance and a 7-minute slowdown do not alert.
